snippet.title: From Vision to World: Scars of Honor Dev Diary
snippet.description:
Scars of Honor began as a personal challenge: to build a true MMORPG inspired by classic fantasy worlds and old-school MMO design.

What began as a one-person project slowly grew into a full team working on a classical fantasy MMORPG focused on exploration, progression, PvE, and PvP.

In this video, we talk about the vision behind Scars of Honor, the world of Aragon, its races and classes, the scar system, talent trees, and the PvP and PvE experiences you’ll find in the game.

👉 Wishlist Scars of Honor on Steam and follow the journey: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4253010/Scars_of_Honor/

#ScarsOfHonor #MMORPG #GameDevelopment #PvE #PvP 

---
Scars of Honor is an upcoming, free-to-play, no pay-to-win MMORPG.
Join the 100% community-driven development and work side-by-side with the developers, to create the best possible game!

Join us now: https://www.beastburst.com/games/scars-of-honor/en
